contract.name: partner_id
contract.description: The official SSP and DSP templates place the provisioned partner ID in this physical path slot. Nonempty presence is template advice. No numeric, UUID, length, allocation or decoded-ID grammar is documented.

contract.name: remote_uid
contract.description: Both official matching templates substitute the partner's user ID in remote_uid. Nonempty presence is template advice. Values and extras remain opaque. Ordinary engine extraction also accepts a form-body carrier in a complete capture; no query-only or receiver acceptance claim is made.
